$schema_note: Graph-friendly intro/outro data for all 60 Whispering Wishes combat-db characters. 'outro' describes what a character grants to the next resonator swapped in (per calcEngine.js's outroBuffs/target:'next' or 'team' convention); 'intro' describes what happens on that character's own entry. Sourced primarily from each characters/<slug>.json kit.skills.intro/outro field (already Prydwen-sourced per SOURCES_STATUS.md) plus that file's own 'teams' section for candidate outro->intro synergy pairings. skillName/damageTypeAffected/durationApprox are heuristically parsed from the prose description and may be null when the source prose didn't state them plainly — treat null as 'not confirmed', not zero.
